mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months (as measured by the FEDFUNDS series) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy that is not accommodative for the current economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payrolls signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the recession deepens.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a post-recession housing recovery, a sustained increase in housing starts above the 12-month moving average signals improving consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances during the post-recession housing recovery regime when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the recession deepens.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has been rising over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a severe labor market deterioration that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the core inflation rate signals a stagflationary risk, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls and CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a manufacturing recovery, a sustained increase in industrial production above its 6-month moving average signals improving economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances during the manufacturing recovery regime when INDPRO is above its 6-month moving average.
